hypothesis: The marginal 6/6 unanimity premium is front-loaded: when full multi-timeframe consensus arrives late in an already-active risk-on campaign, fade only the final one-third breadth contribution over the existing 7-day short-horizon clock while leaving 4/6 and 5/6 states unchanged.
motivation_note: This hypothesis was motivated by 2026 diagnostics, so 2026 is not treated as an independent validation sample. The validation gate is the pre-2026 history plus the external 2020-2021 holdout and the independent OKX venue.
baseline: Frozen 50/50 BTC+ETH sleeve: completed 7d/28d direction votes, completed 4h SMA18/50 votes, 20% volatility cap, 28d downside-semivolatility cap, one-hour delayed execution.

candidate.parameter_selection: none; 168h is the already-existing 7d short horizon

marginal_unanimity_premium_gross_by_camp.note: Gross contribution of the final 1/3 risk-cap sleeve when 6/6 is active; realized one hour after the causal signal.

timing_control.method: Reverse the exact candidate freshness weights within each contiguous risk-on campaign, preserving the campaign-level weight multiset while moving higher unanimity premium to later 6/6 observations.

conclusion.reason: The age-decay rule helps the 2026 diagnostic on both venues, but the hypothesis was motivated by 2026 and fails the independent validation gate: it sacrifices roughly 13 percentage points of cumulative return on Binance 2022-2025 and roughly 14 percentage points on OKX 2022-2025, and also loses about 8.5 percentage points on the external 2020-2021 holdout. The stale >7d unanimity premium was strongly positive in 2023-2025 and 2020-2021. Therefore 2026 late-consensus weakness is regime-specific, not a stable structural reason to fade 6/6.
conclusion.next_direction: Do not tune age cutoffs or decay rates. Keep the frozen unanimity logic. The next distinct hypothesis should explain the 2026 regime change using information orthogonal to simple campaign age, ideally trend quality / volatility-state transition measured causally at the moment consensus forms, with pre-2026 and cross-venue controls.
